text: He asked the question he had been carrying, maybe his whole life.
Good teacher — what do I have to do to live forever with God?
Jesus pointed him to the commandments.
Honor your father and your mother.
And the young man answered: Teacher, I have kept every one of them since I was a boy.
This was not a proud man showing off.
This was a student who had done all the homework, kneeling in the dirt, asking if it was enough.
